key_concepts: Evaporation separates mixtures by heating the solution until the solvent evaporates
Solid residue is left behind after evaporation
Heat is the main factor needed for evaporation
Liquid changes to gas or vapor when heated
Boiling water is an example of evaporation
Drying clothes is an example of evaporation
Drying of wet roads after rain is an example of evaporation
Salt can be obtained from seawater through evaporation
Evaporation is used in everyday activities such as salt making and drying wet floors
